name: gradients
title: Gradient swatches
summary: Three gradient fills: a two-colour horizontal linear gradient on a rounded square, a rainbow sweep gradient around a disc, and an off-centre radial gradient with stops that shades a disc into a lit sphere.
prompt: Three swatches side by side: a linear gradient, a sweep (conic) gradient and a radial gradient.
teaches: Fill a shape with a linearGradient paint op between (x1, y1) and (x2, y2)
Draw a colour wheel with sweepGradient around (centerX, centerY), repeating the first colour last to close it
Shade a disc into a sphere with a radialGradient whose centre is offset towards the light, placing colours with stops
Clear the gradient with the paint key shader 0 before drawing solid text
Fit a drawing authored at the header size to any box: a variable s = min(componentWidth() / W, componentHeight() / H), a translate by half the extra space and a scale by s about the design's centre
pitfalls: Gradients are only read inside a paint's "ops" array: {"paint": {"linearGradient": ...}} is ignored by the Java reference parser (json2rc refuses it); write {"paint": {"ops": [{"linearGradient": ...}]}}
Gradient coordinates are canvas coordinates, not relative to the shape: x1/x2 must span the shape's own left and right, and the radial centre is near the disc's, not at 0,0
The gradient stays on the paint: without shader 0 the labels are drawn with the last gradient instead of their colour
A sweep gradient seams at 3 o'clock unless the last colour repeats the first
stops must have one entry per colour, increasing from 0 to 1

Canvas coordinates are pixels of the box the host gives the document, not of the header: literal coordinates sit in the top-left and get cut off when it is resized, so scale the drawing to fit (or derive positions from componentWidth()/componentHeight())

snippets.note: linearGradient from x 20 to 120, blue to violet, inside paint ops
sweepGradient around (180, 70), seven colours, first repeated last
radialGradient centred up-left of the disc, white highlight at stop 0.3 fading to navy
shader 0 removes the gradient from the paint
the disc the radial gradient fills
a label centred under its swatch (panX 0, panY 0)

check.describe: A blue-to-violet rounded square, a smooth rainbow disc with no seam, and a blue sphere lit from the upper left. Resized, the whole drawing scales uniformly to fit and stays centred (smaller in a narrow box, centred with margins in a wide one).
